claude.rationale: This was structured as a whole-company merger in which Scripps continued as a wholly-owned surviving subsidiary of Discovery, so the customer-facing product tier (HGTV, Food Network, Travel Channel and related brands, T4) crossed the ownership boundary together with Scripps' entire operating entity and processes (T5) — product and processes moved together as one intact company, so gap_45 = 0. Likewise the operating/people tier (T6) transferred coherently alongside the processes: Discovery agreed to honor existing Scripps employment agreements, severance plans, and a fixed through-2018 compensation-continuation period with prior-service crediting, and only the top board and CEO were replaced, so processes did not transfer stripped of the organization that runs them (gap_56 = 0). Because no structural gap was coded, gap_mitigated is NA; the continuity mechanisms ran through Discovery honoring pre-existing arrangements rather than a standalone transition-services agreement.
